title: Colbert Fossil Plant
extract: Colbert Fossil Plant is an operating power station of at least 1230-megawatts (MW) in Tuscumbia, Colbert, Alabama, United States with multiple units, some of which are not currently operating. It is also known as Colbert Combustion Turbine Plant.
